test_title: PYST 40: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

His explanation is always __concise__.
solution:
The correct answer is Lengthy. 

*__Keypoint __

__
 
• **Lengthy** (adj) (especially in reference to time) of considerable or unusual length, especially so as to be tedious.

 
 
• eg. *"lengthy delays"**​*
 
 
 
• **Concise:** G*iving a lot of information clearly and in a few words; brief but comprehensive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Frank** (adj) is open, honest, and direct in speech or writing, especially when dealing with unpalatable matters.

 
 
• eg. *"a long and frank discussion"*
 
 
 
• **Precise** (adj) marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail.
 
 
• eg.* "precise directions"*
 
 
 
• **​Intelligent **(adj) having or showing intelligence, especially of a high level.
 
 
• eg. *"Anna is intelligent and hard-working"*
